svg.title: ReSubmit — a journey from rejection to finding a better-fit venue
svg.desc: A minimal illustrated universe of many small venue planets. A calm curved golden route begins beside a cracked rejection planet, passes research possibilities and leads to a welcoming best-fit venue. This is symbolic project artwork, not real conference data.

g.text: From rejection to a better-fit research home.

svg.text: ILLUSTRATION ONLY · NOT A CONFERENCE RANKING OR ACCEPTANCE FORECAST
